title: Spynixx Launcher v1.2.6 - Custom Wallpaper Themes
content: Spynixx Launcher v1.2.6 is now available.
Added Alyn-style Custom Background Wallpaper support under Settings > Appearance & Wallpaper.
Choose your own image wallpaper (.jpg, .png, .webp) directly from your computer.
Adjust dynamic background blur (0px - 20px) and dark dim overlay (20% - 95%) with instant preview.
Click Update Now below to automatically download and upgrade your launcher.
